newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea probes creditor banks of Hanbo.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea probes creditor banks of Hanbo.

text.p: South Korea's banking watchdog said it opened an investigation on Wednesday into the five main creditor banks of debt-stricken Hanbo Steel Co.
The banks are Korea First Bank, Korea Development Bank, Cho Hung Bank, Korea Exchange Bank and SEOULBANK, a statement by the Office of Bank Supervision said.
Hanbo Steel, South Korea's second largest steelmaker, filed for court receivership on Tuesday after piling up about five trillion won ($5.8 bilion) of loans from 61 banks and financial institutions.
"The special investigation will involve five teams comprising 35 investigators," the statement said.
It said the probe would focus on whether the banks followed regulations in offering loans to Hanbo, which defaulted on debt payments last week.

Opposition parties, calling the loans the biggest financial scandal in the country's history, have accused the government of peddling influence to pressure creditor banks into offering loans to Hanbo without adequate collateral.
